excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
excerpt.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.
